div.p: Software Engineer · Information Systems student · Yogyakarta, Indonesia

ul.li: 🎮 I enjoy reverse engineering games, building my own cheats, and using them whenever I play.
📺 I also share my game cheats on my YouTube channels: @peenjeee & @peenjeeech, and on Telegram: @peenjeeech.

div.p: Information Systems student at University of AMIKOM Yogyakarta. I mainly build web and software products, with data analysis and AI on the side. Currently building SertiKu through the Amikom Business Park incubator and interning as a full-stack developer at the AMIKOM Information Systems study program.
